title: Orioles claim outfielder Luis Robert Jr. off waivers from Mets (August 31)
dek: Baltimore claimed outfielder Luis Robert Jr. off outright waivers from the New York Mets on Monday. The move is part of the Orioles' September roster push as they position for the postseason.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: The Orioles acquired established outfielder Luis Robert Jr. via waiver claim from the Mets on Monday.
bottom_line: Robert Jr. is now on Baltimore's roster pending any eligibility or timing requirements. His contribution to the Orioles' lineup will be clear once he takes the field.
body: The Baltimore Orioles claimed outfielder Luis Robert Jr. off outright waivers from the New York Mets on Monday, per MLB.com. The transaction is part of Baltimore's September roster moves as the team positions itself for a postseason push.
Robert Jr. is an established outfielder who could immediately upgrade the Orioles' outfield composition as the September stretch unfolds.
